Stax layers

Source: R/example_stax.R
stax_layers.Rd

Ports of the layers of jax.example_libraries.stax. A layer is a pair list(init_fun, apply_fun): init_fun(rng, input_shape) returns list(output_shape, params) and apply_fun(params, inputs, ...) applies the layer (stax_Dropout needs a key passed as rng = key). Shapes are integer vectors whose batch entry may be -1; parameterless layers have params list().

Usage

stax_Dense(
  out_dim,
  W_init = nn_initializers_glorot_normal(),
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal()
)

stax_GeneralConv(
  dimension_numbers,
  out_chan,
  filter_shape,
  strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  W_init = NULL,
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal(1e-06)
)

stax_Conv(
  out_chan,
  filter_shape,
  strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  W_init = NULL,
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal(1e-06)
)

stax_GeneralConvTranspose(
  dimension_numbers,
  out_chan,
  filter_shape,
  strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  W_init = NULL,
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal(1e-06)
)

stax_Conv1DTranspose(
  out_chan,
  filter_shape,
  strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  W_init = NULL,
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal(1e-06)
)

stax_ConvTranspose(
  out_chan,
  filter_shape,
  strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  W_init = NULL,
  b_init = nn_initializers_normal(1e-06)
)

stax_BatchNorm(
  axis = c(0L, 1L, 2L),
  epsilon = 1e-05,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  beta_init = nn_initializers_zeros,
  gamma_init = nn_initializers_ones
)

stax_elementwise(fun, ...)

stax_Tanh

stax_Relu

stax_Exp

stax_LogSoftmax

stax_Softmax

stax_Softplus

stax_Sigmoid

stax_Elu

stax_LeakyRelu

stax_Selu

stax_Gelu

stax_MaxPool(window_shape, strides = NULL, padding = "VALID", spec = NULL)

stax_SumPool(window_shape, strides = NULL, padding = "VALID", spec = NULL)

stax_AvgPool(window_shape, strides = NULL, padding = "VALID", spec = NULL)

stax_Flatten

stax_Identity

stax_FanOut(num)

stax_FanInSum

stax_FanInConcat(axis = -1L)

stax_Dropout(rate, mode = "train")

Arguments

out_dim

Output dimension of stax_Dense.

W_init, b_init

Initializers of the weights and biases (see nn_initializers). The default W_init of the convolutions is a Glorot normal initializer over the kernel's I and O axes.

dimension_numbers

Three layout strings (input, kernel, output).

out_chan

Number of output channels.

filter_shape

Integer vector of kernel spatial sizes.

strides

Integer vector of strides (default 1).

padding

"VALID", "SAME", "SAME_LOWER" or a list of c(low, high) pairs.

axis

0-based axes standardized by stax_BatchNorm; axis of stax_FanInConcat.

epsilon

Variance correction of stax_BatchNorm.

center, scale

Whether stax_BatchNorm has a bias (beta) and a scale (gamma).

beta_init, gamma_init

Initializers of beta and gamma.

fun

Elementwise function.

...

Further arguments passed to fun by stax_elementwise.

window_shape

Integer vector of window sizes over the spatial dimensions.

spec

Optional layout string such as "NHWC" naming the batch and channel dimensions of the pooling input.

num

Number of copies made by stax_FanOut.

rate

Keep probability of stax_Dropout (kept values are divided by rate).

mode

"train" applies dropout; any other value returns the inputs.

Value

A layer list(init_fun, apply_fun).

Details

stax_Dense is a fully connected layer inputs %*% W + b. stax_GeneralConv and stax_GeneralConvTranspose are (transposed) convolutions with layouts given as three strings such as c("NHWC", "HWIO", "NHWC"); stax_Conv, stax_ConvTranspose and stax_Conv1DTranspose fix the layouts to NHWC/HWIO and NHC/HIO. stax_BatchNorm standardizes over axis. stax_MaxPool, stax_SumPool and stax_AvgPool pool over windows of the spatial dimensions (the dimensions other than N and C of spec, by default the first and last). stax_elementwise makes a layer from an elementwise function; stax_Tanh, stax_Relu, stax_Exp, stax_LogSoftmax, stax_Softmax, stax_Softplus, stax_Sigmoid, stax_Elu, stax_LeakyRelu, stax_Selu, stax_Gelu, stax_Flatten, stax_Identity and stax_FanInSum are layers. stax_FanOut copies its input num times, stax_FanInSum adds a list of inputs and stax_FanInConcat concatenates them along axis.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
layer <- stax_serial(stax_Dense(4L), stax_Relu, stax_Dense(1L))
res <- layer$init_fun(random_key(0), c(-1L, 3L))
layer$apply_fun(res$params, jnp_ones(c(2, 3)))
} # }
